The claims are assessed using specially developed algorithms and enforced in court through highly automated processes.

product.description: RightNow purchases legal claims from consumers and pays a large portion of the claim within days, relieving consumers from pursuing lengthy legal processes.

product.description: RightNow buys claims from consumers whose energy providers unlawfully terminated contracts, offering immediate compensation for increased energy costs.

product.name: Online Gambling Loss Compensation
